post.title: Nail salons spend 78 cents of every dollar. Here's where.
post.ig:
In 2022, US nail salons spent 78 cents of every dollar they took in.

Census data for salons with employees: $12.9B in revenue, $10.1B in expenses (2022).
Revenue dipped to $6.4B in 2020, then reached $12.9B in 2022.
Hypothetical $30 manicure: $15 to the tech at a 50% commission (a common rule of thumb), $3 supplies and $8 rent and bills (assumed) leave $4, about 13%.
Median manicurist pay was $16.66 an hour in May 2024 (BLS).

Sources: US Census Bureau Service Annual Survey (via FRED), BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook, Zenoti.
